verdict.rationale: No first-party evidence shows GitBook publishing its source under an open license. One old community comment says 'most of the product is open-source', but later community reports say GitBook moved to its SaaS platform and abandoned open source, and that the legacy CLI is no longer actively developed. Nothing establishes that the current product's source is readable under an open license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
